messages:
release-bot: Starting deploy for release/2026-03-20 by alex. Trigger: tag v2.1.4. Canaries: svc-a -> infra-c. CI: pending.

ci-bot: Build failed in job 'publish-artifact' — error during cache restore. See logs.

alex: CI failing on artifact checksum mismatch when restoring cache — this is blocking the release.

morgan: Can you paste the error snippet?

alex: Sure — logs below:
```
[2026-03-20T14:02:11Z] cache restore: key=runtime-cache-v2 scope=global
[2026-03-20T14:02:12Z] download artifact redwood-runtime-v2.1.4.tar.gz -> checksum expected=abc123 got=def456
[2026-03-20T14:02:12Z] error: checksum mismatch, aborting
[2026-03-20T14:02:13Z] publish: attempt to upload redwood-runtime-v2.1.4.tar.gz failed: 409 Conflict (existing artifact with different checksum)
```

alex: My suspicion: two runners produced slightly different build outputs and the registry ended up with a conflicting artifact under the same name. The pipeline refuses to overwrite, so publish failed and later jobs can't find a valid artifact.

jen: We saw something similar in late Jan. Options: 1) purge conflicting artifact in registry, 2) bump artifact name (include content hash), 3) re-run builds with deterministic flags. Purging during change window needs coordination.

sam: We shouldn't purge registry during today's change window unless it's a true emergency. Quick path to unblock release: pin the canary to last-known-good artifact (v2.1.3) and re-run canary with SKIP_CACHE or a manual publish. That avoids touching registry.

alex: I'll try re-running pipeline with SKIP_CACHE=1 and explicitly pin image -> runtime:v2.1.3 for canary. If that passes, we can at least get canary out and hold on full rollout.

morgan: If re-run still fails on publish (409), we need to create a rollback/pr to pin to v2.1.3. Prepare a PR so we can merge quickly.

alex: Running retry: ./ci/retry.sh 1750123456 --env SKIP_CACHE=1 --no-cache\\n

ci-bot: Pipeline 1750123456-2 started. Jobs queued: build, unit-tests, integration, publish-artifact.

ci-bot: build: success. unit-tests: success. integration: failed — cannot locate artifact redwood-runtime-v2.1.4.tar.gz in registry.

morgan: Wait — integration failing because publish didn't complete. Did the publish step abort?

alex: Publish logs show: 
```
publish: checking existing artifact redwood-runtime-v2.1.4.tar.gz
publish: found artifact with mismatched checksum (existing=abc123, new=def456)
publish: refusing to overwrite existing artifact name -> exit 1
```

jen: So the registry contains an artifact with the same name but different content. Deleting it would let us publish, but that's disruptive. Not allowed without a scheduled maintenance.

sam: Then we should pin to v2.1.3 for the canary path. Open a PR to pin runtime/image and add a release-note explaining the temporary pin and root cause.

alex: PR opened: #402 — pin runtime->v2.1.3 for deploy/canary, add release note and follow-up ticket to add content-hash to artifact filenames. Assigning @morgan for quick review.

morgan: Reviewing now. If approved, I can kick off a manual canary deploy to 10% and monitor.

deploy-bot: Manual canary deployment requested by morgan. Deployment queued to cluster p-canary.

jen: Add a short release note: "Blocked by artifact checksum conflict in registry; paused full rollout; canary deployed at 10% using pinned runtime v2.1.3." Also schedule a change window tomorrow 10:00 UTC to allow safe cleanup.

alex: Added release-note blurb and created followup ticket: RD-1293 (add content-hash to artifact name + stricter build determinism).

morgan: Approved PR #402.

alex: CI for PR #402 succeeded, merging now.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started (canary=10%).

ci-bot: artifact publish step: skipped (pinned artifact used).

ci-bot: canary health checks: OK — latency and error-rate within baseline.

morgan: Canary looks healthy for the first 30m. Metrics within 1% for 95th perc latency. Holding full rollout until registry policy is addressed.

jen: I'll book a change window tomorrow 10:00 UTC to coordinate artifact cleanup or migration and to approve any necessary registry deletes. I'll post calendar invite and required runbook.

alex: Thanks all. Action items: merge pin PR (done), monitor canary (morgan), schedule registry work (jen), add build determinism task (alex). Closing thread unless anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
